info.title: Hotel Supplier Hub API
info.description: Searches several hotel suppliers behind one contract, merges the answers by canonical hotel and streams them as they arrive.

post.summary: Search all eligible suppliers and return the merged result once they have answered or the deadline passes.
Search and stream updates as server-sent events while suppliers answer.

get.summary: Replay the buffered events of a search after the Last-Event-ID header, then continue live until it completes.

delete.summary: Cancel a running search started by the same caller.

get.summary: List suppliers with their capabilities, whether the caller's tenant has them enabled, circuit state and in-flight calls.

put.summary: Replace the fault profile of a fake supplier (latency, errors, malformed payloads, hangs).

get.summary: Read an offer from a recent search as the hub holds it now, including any price a re-quote wrote back.

post.summary: Re-price an offer with its supplier and return the amount that can be booked, and until when.
Mark a booking as paid (admin and demo use). A paid pay-later booking is no longer cancelled by the expiry service.
Attach a supplier hotel code to a canonical hotel, minting a new canonical id when none is given.

put.summary: Record that a canonical id was retired in favour of a surviving one.

get.summary: Show the supplier records behind a canonical hotel, following merge history.

post.summary: Book against a live quote and the exact amount it showed. Needs an Idempotency-Key header; repeating the request returns the first outcome.
Ask the supplier what it holds for a pending or unknown booking and update the booking from the answer.
Cancel a booking. The answer says cancelled, penaltyApplied, alreadyCancelled or failed, whatever the supplier answered.
Match every supplier's cities to canonical cities. Accepts clear matches, queues the rest for review, and changes nothing that is already decided.

get.summary: The supplier city codes known to mean a canonical city, optionally for one supplier.
Supplier cities waiting for a person to decide (status pending by default).

post.summary: Map the supplier city to a canonical city (the proposal, or the one named in the body).
Decide that the supplier city is not any canonical city; later runs leave it alone.

ApiKey.description: API key that identifies the caller, its tenant and its role.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
